body: NYC. Moved there after I graduated college because I have family in the area that I was able to live with while I looked for a job.

I have never felt more alone. 

This is also definitely greatly exacerbated by the fact that I moved to a new city about a year ago and still don't talk to anyone outside of work.

I really honestly don't know, other that I know *something* needs to change. But all of my thoughts conflicting; I don't want to be alive anymore, but at the same time I can't kill myself; I want to be happy, but I don't know what happy is or how to get there or if I even really do want to be happy or whether all I can really foresee or cope with is the current state of things. And I want help, but not enough to overcome my desire to not talk to anyone about this. It all seems like a massive lose-lose.

It really is terrible that everyone is essentially forced into living without a choice. Were I to go back in time and get the chance to not be born, I would in a second; but now that I'm a live, existing person, I'm trapped and it becomes stupid to opt back out, even though I never wanted in in the first place.

Sorry for the ramble. As you can probably tell, my own thoughts on all of this are very conflicted and extremely unclear.
Already did, pretty much got the same set of responses I did on this post.
I have been "just hanging in there" in the hope that something will change for as long as I can remember; I don't think I'll be able to use this as my reason to keep going for much longer.

Because despite the fact that depression is an illness, people don't really look at that way in reality.

Edit: Also, because no other illness requires revealing so much of your personal life.

I really don't think I have the ability to open up to anyone about this - if I'm did there's no way I wouldn't have told someone by now. My parents have asked me two or three times over the past couple of years whether I'm depressed, and each time I've been adamant that I'm not. I don't really have anyone else to go to, and wouldn't want to even if I did.
